content.title: Compass, Anywhere Merger Creates Real Estate Giant. How Browsing Home Listings Is About to Change.
content.summary: Compass  on Friday said it completed its $1.6 billion merger with the real estate brokerage  Anywhere Real Estate  uniting the first and second largest brokerages by sales volume and bringing roughly 340,000 real estate professionals under one roof.  Among the combined companies’ priorities is building a spiderweb of brokerage-run home listings websites,  Compass  CEO Robert Reffkin wrote in a letter to agents.  Anywhere, formerly Realogy, is the parent of brands such as Coldwell Banker, Corcoran, and Sotheby’s.
